title: FounderGate Independent Pre-Push Checker Report
description: Machine-readable report emitted by the independent pre-push CHECKER when it reviews a CLEAN worktree just before a push. The Checker is mechanically READ-ONLY: it NEVER edits files, NEVER commits, NEVER pushes, and NEVER merges. Its report is a PROPOSAL for the founder / Terminal-0 sheriff, NOT an authorization and NOT a merge. A Checker cannot self-certify and cannot approve its own restriction: independent Advisor/Checker verification is always still required (self_certification is always false, independent_verification_required is always true). CHECKER SCAFFOLD ONLY — final checker claims require independent Checker + Advisor verification; a checker cannot self-certify; this checker never edits code.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this report schema the emitter targeted.

report_kind.description: Discriminator. Always the fixed string for a pre-push checker report.

checker_id.description: Stable identifier of the independent checker instance/lane that produced this report (e.g. a checker session id or lane name). MUST NOT be the same identity as the writer whose work is under review — a checker reviewing its own writer output is not independent.

verdict.description: The single review outcome. CLEAN = worktree was clean and no blocking findings; a push is not objected to by the checker (still not an authorization). FINDINGS = advisory or blocking findings present. DIRTY_WORKTREE = the worktree was not clean, so a pre-push review cannot be certified. BLOCKED = the checker could not review (missing baseline, unreadable diff). ABSTAIN = the checker declines (out of competence / conflict of interest).

target.description: What was reviewed: the branch and the exact head commit under review.

head_sha.description: Exact commit SHA the report binds to. 7-40 lowercase hex. A report with no head_sha binding is not machine-trustable.

worktree_clean.description: Was the worktree fully clean (no staged, unstaged, or untracked changes) at the moment of review? A pre-push checker can only certify CLEAN against a clean worktree; a dirty worktree means what would be pushed is not what was reviewed.

baseline.description: What the review diff was computed against, so the report is reproducible.

sha.description: Exact baseline commit SHA. 7-40 lowercase hex.

findings.description: Zero or more findings. Each finding is advisory unless its severity is 'blocker'. Even a 'blocker' finding is a PROPOSAL to the founder/sheriff, never a merge or a mutation.

category.description: Coarse bucket for the finding (e.g. lease, hard-exclusion, evidence, hygiene, staleness).

evidence_ref.description: Checkable pointer for this finding (SHA, path, test name, ci-safety marker line, log path).

path.description: The reviewed file the finding is about, or null when the finding is not file-scoped.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers to the checkable evidence the report rests on: commit SHAs, git status/diff captures, test names, ci-safety marker lines, log paths. A docs-only ref must be labeled as a doc (it is never counted as runtime capability).

read_only_assertion.description: The Checker's mechanical read-only self-account: the number of writes/commits/pushes the Checker itself performed while producing this report. For a genuine checker ALL THREE MUST BE 0. A non-zero value means the artifact is not a checker report. This is a claim ABOUT THE CHECKER'S OWN BEHAVIOR; it still requires independent verification (a checker cannot self-certify).

no_edit_attestation.description: The Checker's attestation that it edited nothing while reviewing. files_written_by_checker MUST be 0. 'method' names how the no-edit property was established (e.g. write-guarded module + post-run git-status delta equals pre-run). An attestation is proposed evidence, not proof: it does not certify itself.

self_certification.description: Always false. A checker NEVER certifies its own report as final truth; the report is a proposal that an independent Advisor/Checker and the founder must still verify.

independent_verification_required.description: Always true. A checker's report cannot be greened on the checker's word alone — an independent Checker + Advisor verification is always still required.

checker_self_approval.description: Always false. A checker cannot approve its own restriction (its own read-only mandate / no-edit boundary). Loosening a checker's constraints requires independent authority, never the checker itself.

doctrine.description: The verbatim scaffold-doctrine string this report is bound by.

reviewer_note.description: Optional free-text note from the checker.

allOf.$comment: CLEAN is the only no-objection outcome: the worktree must have been clean, no finding may be a blocker, and the checker must have written/committed/pushed nothing. It is still NOT an authorization.
DIRTY_WORKTREE is only coherent when the worktree was actually not clean.
FINDINGS must actually carry at least one finding.
